title: Medical camp for students and staff
summary: Health check-ups for students and staff at the Vidyalaya.
body: A medical camp was held at the Vidyalaya for students and staff, offering health check-ups and basic services. Doctors sat as a panel for the gathering, and a registration desk ran through the day. Both are in the photographs with this record.

image.alt: Students lined up outside a school building beneath a medical camp banner.

documents.alt: A panel seated on a stage beneath the medical camp banner.
Two people at a registration desk during the camp.
